name: EduScope Web CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "develop"]
    paths:
      - "eduscope-web/**"
      - ".github/workflows/eduscope-web-ci.yml"
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main", "develop"]
    paths:
      - "eduscope-web/**"
      - ".github/workflows/eduscope-web-ci.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-and-build:
    name: Backend Test, Package and Docker Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"
          cache: maven
          cache-dependency-path: eduscope-web/pom.xml

      - name: Make Maven Wrapper executable
        working-directory: eduscope-web
        run: chmod +x mvnw

      - name: Run CI tests and package
        working-directory: eduscope-web
        run: ./mvnw -B -Pci clean verify

      - name: Upload test reports on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: eduscope-web-surefire-reports
          path: eduscope-web/target/surefire-reports/
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Verify Docker image build
        run: docker build --tag eduscope-web:ci ./eduscope-web
